instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Regional supermarket chain operating 28 stores across central and northern Portugal. Private-label program accounts for 35% of revenue. Currently rolling out self-checkout kiosks and evaluating AI-driven demand forecasting to reduce fresh produce waste by 25%. A tight-knit operation where everyone wears multiple hats. We have no dedicated innovation budget — improvements happen opportunistically when the team identifies a clear bottleneck affecting our core operations or customer experience.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have never run a formal innovation initiative. Problems are solved ad-hoc as they arise, usually by the most directly affected team member. There is no dedicated budget, no structured ideation process, and no track record of experimenting with new technologies or business models beyond basic operational necessity.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next 2 years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows. We are not looking to grow headcount — we want to do more with our existing team.

input.changes_since_last: Hired 2 new team members. Launched customer feedback pilot. Budget for innovation increased 15%.

opportunities.title: End-to-End Process Automation Audit (Core Workflow Mapping)
opportunities.rationale: The primary goal is reducing OpEx by 15%, which requires identifying manual choke points across order processing, invoicing, and support. This opportunity formalizes the process mapping required before any automation investment can yield reliable ROI.

first_actions: Select three high-volume cross-functional processes (e.g., PO to Invoice).
Conduct 'day in the life' workshops with key stakeholders across departments.
Document current state workflows using BPMN notation.
execution_plan.success_metric: Creation of 3 fully mapped, optimized 'To-Be' process models.
milestones: Completion of initial current state mapping (Month 1).
Identification and prioritization of automation bottlenecks (Month 2).

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Waste Reduction & Inventory Optimization
opportunities.rationale: The focus on fresh produce waste reduction (25%) is a clear, measurable operational efficiency goal. Leveraging customer feedback and sales data for advanced forecasting will directly impact the bottom line.

first_actions: Consolidate historical POS/inventory data into a single clean dataset.
Pilot basic predictive modeling using current AI tools on 1-2 product categories (e.g., fresh produce).
Establish KPIs for waste reduction vs baseline.
execution_plan.success_metric: Demonstrable 10%+ reduction in targeted product spoilage within 6 months.
milestones: Initial forecast model deployed and tested on one region (Month 3).

opportunities.title: Establishing a Formalized Innovation & Experimentation Playbook
opportunities.rationale: Currently, innovation is purely ad-hoc. To sustain efficiency gains and manage the increased budget (27%), Atlas must formalize how ideas are sourced, vetted, and tested. This structural change mitigates cultural risk.

first_actions: Define a simple 'Idea Intake' form capturing problem statement, suggested solution, and estimated ROI.
Allocate small, ring-fenced funds for rapid prototyping (Proof of Concept funding).
execution_plan.success_metric: Formal approval and execution of 1 new, high-ROI PoC per quarter.
milestones: Playbook draft finalized and communicated company-wide (Month 2).

next_steps.action: Execute the process mapping workshops for high-volume workflows (Opportunity: End-to-End Process Automation Audit).
Formalize the dedicated innovation process by drafting and presenting the 'Innovation Playbook' to ownership.
Gather historical sales, inventory loss reports, and customer feedback data for initial AI model preparation (Opportunity: Waste Reduction).

key_weaknesses: Lack of formal process documentation leading to high operational risk.
Reliance on 'ad-hoc' problem solving limits scalability and repeatability.
Strategy remains too focused on immediate cost cuts, potentially neglecting long-term customer experience gains.

improvements: Successfully launched a customer feedback pilot program.
Clear strategic focus established on tangible OpEx reduction targets (15%).
persistent_gaps: Absence of standardized, documented processes across the organization.
No formal mechanism for idea capture or investment in internal innovation.
Gap between identifying a bottleneck and implementing scalable technical solutions.
achieved_milestones: Successful initiation of customer feedback collection.
Clear alignment on waste reduction targets (25% goal).

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Increased funding and structural efforts (pilots, budget increase) have moved the company past 'none' maturity toward structured process improvement opportunities.
